question: Among US adults on Twitter in 2018, what share of all tweets came from the most active 10% of users?
answer: About 80%. Pew Research found the busiest tenth of American adult users wrote about four in five tweets, while the median user posted about twice a month. A storm that seems to involve everyone online is often a small, very loud group, watched by a much larger silent one.
move: The loudest tenth of any room is not the room.
ask: When it feels like everyone is angry about something, how many people have I actually heard from?
trap: Assuming users post roughly equally, so the top tenth writes little more.
source: Pew Research Center, Sizing Up Twitter Users
reference: Pew Research Center, Sizing Up Twitter Users, 24 April 2019
